summary: An owner offered a ready replacement has to compare it with the product that broke.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). The final report describes an exception when the manufacturer provides a readily available equivalent or better product free to the owner.
inGame: needs: the manufacturer invokes the free-replacement exception.
gates: The manufacturer invokes the free-replacement exception.

turns.what: The replacement falls short of the original.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement lacks a feature the owner needs and the original had.

turns.what: An equivalent device can go home with the owner.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement matches the original and is available now at no cost.
turns.writesBack: The replacement offer meets those conditions.
